description: Web derivatives of 160 final Zebra App Store posters across 4 device groups and 4 languages (zh-Hans, en-US, ja, fr-FR). Only proportional resizing and WebP encoding were applied to the frozen posters. iPhone Duo uses the inner-display posters.
